# Lua 5.4.7 (vendored)

Source: `https://github.com/lua/lua.git`, tag `v5.4.7` (commit `1ab3208a1fceb12fca8f24ba57d6e13c5bff15e3`).
Copied unmodified, minus the standalone interpreter (`lua.c`), the test harness
(`ltests.c`, `ltests.h`), the amalgamation (`onelua.c`), the test suite and the manual.
